name: Garita Skipperling
desc: Garita Skipperling (Oarisma garita): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Oarisma garita, the Garita skipperling, western skipperling or Garita skipper, is a North American butterfly in the family Hesperiidae (skippers), subfamily Hesperiinae (grass skippers).
